observation.sourceFootprint: Full photograph, rectified with calibrated WCS. No manual scale, rotation, or displacement.
observation.intensityMeaning: Rec.709-weighted encoded sRGB display signal; not linear radiance or a gas-density measurement.

prior.meaning: Trilinearly filtered encoded stellar support decoded after filtering, sampled on calibrated observer rays. Relative clipped/quantized density prior; no luminosities, dust, or measured star depths.

limitations: The native display composite determines angular positions and color; it is not calibrated flux.
The full photograph footprint is retained. This footprint does not cover the full stellar simulation or establish where gas lies outside the photograph.
Compact candidates are a morphological top-hat channel, not identified foreground stars. Their light is excluded from both compared cloud targets and shown separately.
The simulation provides approximate stellar depth support; fitted emission shapes and thickness are hypotheses, not measured gas or dust.
No arbitrary 3x photo fit or authored rotation is applied. The source density is unchanged.
Display emission only: no dust extinction or radiative transfer is recovered.
This pair renders only the extended morphological channel. The omitted compact candidates and diffuse remainder are shown separately; neither is asserted to be measured foreground light.

volume.opticalTransfer: Selected display intensity is mapped once through -log(1-signal)/exposure; normalized depth profiles preserve that optical column.
claimLimitations: This is a display reconstruction, not a physical gas-density or distance measurement.
The stellar density is only a weak relative depth prior.
Compact candidates are an explicit image channel, not claimed stellar membership.

projected.meaning: Physical Earth-ray integration before texture quantization. A projection fit does not validate unobserved geometry.

bakeSupport.method: Conservative emission support computed after depth assignment; the entire source prior remains unchanged.

approximation.method: Direct XYZ emissivity samples per kpc; shared exponential opacity and optical RGB ratios; lossless full-extent RGBA8 masters. Delivery textures are area-downsampled from those PNG bytes in premultiplied display RGB, then unpremultiplied, cropped and encoded.
approximation.radialEmission: Provided entirely by the authored emissivity sampler.
limitations: This is display emission, not calibrated photometry; extinction is unsupported.
Shared opacity preserves column-constant chromaticity before RGBA8 quantization; varying chromaticity is a slab approximation.
Higher master resolution improves in-plane sampling only. Finite samples along each slab depth can alias high-frequency photograph detail, especially in X/Y banks.
Finite slabs, RGBA8 alpha and axis handoffs approximate a continuous volume.
Delivery downsampling averages already quantized slab coverage; lossy WebP changes RGB while alpha encoding is lossless.
